description: This file is a shell script test suite for Git commit functionality, including multiple test cases for commit behavior, options, and edge cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
